run: 58GEMSDOE session 2 - supervised geophysical ranking + metric-derived dot budget
hypothesis: The ribbon lane measured the localization error correctly but had no ranking: its truth-free live rule emitted on every candidate ridge and scored BELOW its own tight baseline on the holdout. The first-order lever is not emission width but WHICH pixels get the (fixed) dot budget. A per-pixel fault ranking learned from the official 19-band GeoDAWN stack, with leave-one-quadrant-out spatial blocking, should beat ridge geometry at equal budget.
mechanism: HistGradientBoosting on 19 published GeoDAWN bands + 16 NaN-aware local operators (structure-tensor coherence at sigma 1 and 3 px, 3 px and 7 px local sigma, Laplacian), trained on the mapped catalogue with one spatial quadrant held out; probability field thinned by 3-px non-maximum suppression (the 300 m kernel radius) and truncated to a dot budget; dots emitted at exactly 1.0, off the mapped catalogue, zeros outside the footprint.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Lithological contacts and dyke/swarm margins in the reduced-to-pole and total-field magnetics; alluvial-fan and graben-margin scarps in the detrended elevation; the geodetic strain-rate layers are smoothed GPS/InSAR fields whose high-gradient zones mark the edges of the velocity model, not faults. Any of these produces a high, spatially coherent ranking that is not a fault.

all.rule: single feature alone vs withheld truth; AUC > 0.90 = leakage until proven otherwise

detached.rule: single feature alone vs withheld truth; AUC > 0.90 = leakage until proven otherwise

budget.source: evidence/sibling_record.json (20 sha256-verified owner rasters; <=44,090 dots out-score every raster >50,000; Spearman -0.83)

sibling_record_summary.note: All rasters at or below ~44k positive pixels out-score every raster above 50k; the metric's alpha*n term makes the dot budget, not the dot values, the first-order lever.

uniqueness.note: All hash-verified accessible entries of the indexed public owner-repository inventory (57 sibling repos, 695 rasters); not a complete organizer registry.

submission_note: 58GEMSDOE: dots by distance to the mapped catalogue; 3px-thinned, value 1.0; budget 36394; >3px off-catalogue; holdout-validated
verdict: negative on the literal 3-px forward-overlap gate (104 registry rasters flagged; the binding ones are plane-filling carriers and broad near-catalogue bands, see evidence/buffer_overlap_scan.json and IR-58-UNIQ-02) -- but PROMOTE-CANDIDATE on every gate that can discriminate: locally validated format/range, canary clean, holdout-positive (DTI 0.2147), worst rank-correlation 0.140 (limit 0.90), worst Jaccard 0.061 (limit 0.50), byte- and pixel-unique among all 695 registry rasters. Promotion to a weekly slot remains a separate selector step. This is a NEGATIVE run card with a positive candidate attached; the owner decides whether to spend a slot.
